title: DSP Pension Fund NPS Review: Returns, Portfolio, and Fees (2026)
description: DSP Pension Fund, a relatively newer entrant, offers National Pension System (NPS) investment options across equity, corporate bonds, and government securitie.

faq.q: What is the National Pension System (NPS)?
faq.a: NPS is a voluntary, long-term savings scheme regulated by PFRDA, designed to help individuals build a retirement corpus. It offers market-linked returns and tax benefits under Sections 80C, 80CCD(1), and 80CCD(1B) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

faq.q: How does DSP Pension Fund fit into NPS?
faq.a: DSP Pension Fund is one of the Pension Fund Managers (PFMs) approved by PFRDA. Subscribers can choose DSP to manage their NPS contributions, which it then invests across various asset classes like equity, corporate bonds, and government securities according to the chosen investment strategy.

faq.q: Can I switch my Pension Fund Manager (PFM)?
faq.a: Yes, NPS subscribers have the flexibility to switch their PFM once a year for Tier I accounts. This can be done online through the NPS portal or by submitting a physical request to your Point of Presence (PoP).

faq.q: What is the difference between Active Choice and Auto Choice?
faq.a: Active Choice allows subscribers to manually decide their asset allocation across Equity, Corporate Bonds, and Government Securities. Auto Choice, or Lifecycle Fund, automatically adjusts the asset allocation based on the subscriber's age, gradually reducing equity exposure as they get older.

No, NPS returns are market-linked and are not guaranteed. The value of your investment can go up or down depending on the performance of the underlying assets managed by your chosen Pension Fund Manager.

faq.q: What are the tax benefits of investing in NPS?
faq.a: NPS offers tax benefits under Section 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakhs), Section 80CCD(1) (employer's contribution up to 10% of salary), and an additional deduction under Section 80CCD(1B) for contributions up to ₹50,000, which is over and above the 80C limit.
